recognize_zh: 視野中央有一顆雙核的晚期紅血球母細胞（兩個大小相近、染色質濃縮的圓核共用一片灰粉色細胞質），旁邊多顆紅系前驅細胞染色質顆粒粗細不一，提示紅系發育不良（erythroid dysplasia）。
features: Binucleate late erythroblast with two round, condensed, equal-sized nuclei in grey-pink cytoplasm (center)
Several erythroid precursors with coarsely granular chromatin and variably basophilic cytoplasm, some with irregular nuclear outlines
A basophilic erythroblast with deeply blue cytoplasm and cytoplasmic blebs adjacent to the binucleate cell
Small pyknotic orthochromatic erythroblasts scattered in the field
Hypocellular, spread-out aspirate area with background mature red cells; Romanowsky-type staining despite the H&E label
describe_en: Bone marrow aspirate smear shows a spread-out field containing scattered erythroid precursors at various stages of maturation. A binucleate late erythroblast with two equal, condensed nuclei is present, and several neighboring erythroblasts show irregular nuclear contours and uneven chromatin; discrete nuclear budding is not clearly resolved at this magnification. The staining pattern is Romanowsky-type rather than H&E. In the context of a complex abnormal karyotype including 17p deletion, the findings are consistent with erythroid dysplasia of a myelodysplastic neoplasm.

ddx.vs: Megaloblastic erythroblasts show open, sieve-like chromatin with nuclear-cytoplasmic asynchrony and giant bands, and resolve with vitamin replacement, whereas MDS shows a clonal karyotype and persists.
CDA II shows a high proportion of binucleate late erythroblasts in a young patient without cytogenetic abnormalities or dysplasia in other lineages.

ddx.dx: Therapy- or toxin-related dyserythropoiesis (e.g., alcohol, chemotherapy, arsenic)
ddx.vs: Reactive dyserythropoiesis is transient with a relevant exposure and lacks a clonal karyotype such as the complex 17p-deleted karyotype here.
